title: A live shiur in the feed — share a follow-me link and the post follows the leader

tasks.title: A shared follow-me session, from the post to the live card and the join

acs.text: WHEN a learner posts with a follow-me link (an address whose `follow` parameter is a 43-character session id) in the source field or in the words THE SYSTEM SHALL keep the session on the post (`followSessionId`) and, unless the learner named a source, take the post's source from the address the link opened on ("/Exodus.3.2" is "Exodus 3:2"). Anything that is not shaped like a session id is ignored.
scenarios: AC-001 a post keeps the session a follow link carries

acs.text: WHEN a viewer asks where a post's session is (`GET /api/v1/posts/{postId}/follow`) THE SYSTEM SHALL answer from the reader's follow-me relay's status read (`GET /status/<sessionId>` with the shared secret): whether someone leads, the ref of the leader's address, the leader's name, whether their tab is hidden for a moment (still live), and how many are in the room. One answer is reused for every viewer for a few seconds, so a busy feed asks the relay about once per session per interval.
scenarios: AC-002 the post says where the leader is now

acs.text: WHEN the session has ended, the relay is not configured, or it does not answer in time THE SYSTEM SHALL answer `live: false` with nothing else; a missing or deleted post, or one without a session, is 404; without a token, 401.
scenarios: AC-003 an ended session, or no relay, is not live

acs.text: The post card SHALL show a shared session as a live source: "Live", who is learning and how many, the leader's current source with its text, updated while the card is on screen and the tab is visible (no socket), and "Join the shiur", which pushes the reader to the leader's place with the link's `follow` parameter so the reader's follow me joins. Once the session has ended the card says so, shows the post's own source and offers no join.
scenarios: AC-004 the card follows the leader and joins the shiur
